CustomField.description: How a Start New Form or View/Edit Form Submission lookup override renders (#391). inline renders c-form-template in place of the lookup input, matching how the component override renders its nested form. modal renders a button instead, labelled by referenceFormButtonLabel__c, which opens the form in a modal headed by referenceFormModalHeader__c / referenceFormModalSubheader__c. Ignored when referenceFieldOverrideType__c is standard or component.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Controls whether the form renders directly on the page or behind a button that opens it in a modal. Inline is the default and keeps the form always visible. Choose Modal when the embedded form is long and would otherwise dominate the page.
CustomField.label: referenceFormDisplayType
